emailContent:
Hi!

 

We are ready to print the Pre-Trip Collateral for the Acoustic 2024 Presidents Club Trip (ACO2501). I have put the link to the files below and listed out the quantities needed for each file. We would like to have these delivered to the Brightspot Office by Wednesday, September 10, 2025. Please let us know if you have any questions. 



Print-Ready Files: ACO2501 Pre-trip (Print Ready)


Pre-trip wallet
Qty: 30

Away Card
Qty:  60 sheets 
Single-sided
These should have a perforation down the middle so they can be torn apart.

Luggage Tags
Qty: 120 (4) per winner, per wallet (pre-stuck) (Confirm)
Acrylic, Double-sided (utilize the same material as Master's Club)
Please include the plastic loops
Can you also include a roll of glue dots for the luggage tags as well?

Letterhead 
Qty: 400 sheets

Thank you! 
==========================

Thanks Jasmine, 

This looks pretty straight forward. I will work on getting them entered and we should have proofs for you tomorrow. No problem on the Sept 10th deadline, that is plenty of time. 

Thanks so much for the order and have a great rest of your day !!

=========================

Hi Jasmine, 

Quick question for you. On the luggage tags, I believe when we did those for masters we printed them on a white acrylic. Shortly after we did those, we decided that they worked better printing them on clear acrylic. We recently did that for the FXO2501 luggage tags that we just delivered to Marissa if you want to take a look at a sample of one - I think those work much better when we print them that way. 

Also - side note - we delivered a full box of 4,000 glue dots last week just so you all have some there in inventory for future use (we seem to have trouble remembering to add them to orders, so we just brought you a stock of them, lol) 

Let me know if that style will work for you on the luggage tags - we have done quite a few that way and so far I think everyone is pretty happy with them when they are looking for something a little nicer than the usual thinner ones. and we had a lot of negative feedback on printing on white - and I did not like the white acrylic as well myself - it does not print as nicely as the clear acrylic prints :) 

=============================

Erich,

Jumping in for Jasmine! We would actually like these printed on the thinner, more traditional luggage tag. This program unfortunately does not have the budget for the nicer acrylic ones which I did see on Marissa's desk and looked great! 

Noted on the glue dots! 

=============================

OK, will do, thanks for the update. 

Have a great Friday !!

======================

Hello!

 I am out of office today and will return tomorrow Monday, September 8th. I will not have access to my email during this time. If it's urgent, feel free to reach out to Christie Rogers at christie.rogers@brightspot.email

I just took care of the payment Erich! 

Quick question, do you create window decals/install decals? 

One of our retailers located in Lake Highlands is interested in getting a decal of the logo attached done for their store window. The dimensions would be 42" wide, 24" tall; white lettering and they'd like to have some kind of "bling or sparkle" detailing on the rings below the logo if that is even possible! 

If you are able to do something like this, I'd love to get some quote info on a standard white decal and if you suggest they install it themselves or you are able to assist, and also any fun ideas you have on making the rings a little blingier. 

Thanks again! 
======================

Hi Izzy, 

We can definitely help you on this, both with creating it and installing it.

I will see what I can find on making it "bling", but I am sure we can come up with some ideas there - I will get something worked up and back to you shortly. 


=============================

Hi Izzy, 

I wanted to run a thought by you on this. I talked to a few of my suppliers and I really did not find anything that really struck me on trying to make the rings bling, but (and this might be a little too out there) what if we just cut the white vinyl and attached some actual "gemstones" to the circles - I have no idea how these would age, but I found these silly stick on gems and when I size everything up to full size the circles are just about a perfect match. I know it is a little out there, but I think it might be a cool look... I just don't know how they would weather, but they are acrylic, so I would think they would hold up pretty well. 

I have a quote attached to do the project turn key with delivery and install. Let me know what you think and I can revert back to something more standard if this is a little to arts and crafts. 

===============================

Hello Erich, 

Thanks for sending this over! I appreciate your creative thinking, but I think you're right, it won't weather well, and we'd like to keep it more classic and simple!

Please send over an adapted quote for the process with just the plain white vinyl. I appreciate you looking into this for us! 

================================

Ok, here is an estimate for just plain white vinyl, I was afraid I went a little too out of the box on that :)

Just let me know what you think. 


================================

Erich,

     I may have an order for 600 name badges that will need to be printed on plastic. I show the last time we did these, the material was on a 14 mil synaps (not sure how to spell that). Can you print on this or something similar enough that the customer will not be able to tell the difference? Also, it will have two slot punches so can you do these? Just let me know. Quantity will be 600. Don’t know the size yet but will find out and send later so you can quote.

Thanks,

Frank Ashby

====================

Hi Frank, 

I stock a 15 Mil rigid PVC, I think they are very similar. I have samples here if you want to take a look. No problem on the slot punches. 

====================

Erich,

     Please see attached and please send quote for a quantity of 600. The print-ready file attached does not include the pink lines. I've also attached a PDF that does shows the pink die lines for reference if needed. This prints on 14 mil synaps or whatever you have that is similar. Please let me know if you have any questions.

Thanks,

Frank Ashby

==========================

Hi Frank, 
Your estimate is ready!

Thanks so much for the opportunity to present you with the attached estimate. 

============================

Erich,

    This order is a go. Please proceed and please send pdf proof for approval.

Thanks,

Frank Ashby

Hello Alison, 

This is the rush job we discussed this morning.  

Let's print 10 units.  Here are the specs: 

Simply Sensational Mini Booklet - 8 Page Self Cover
  4cp / 4cp with Bleeds
  Stock:  100# Gloss Cover
  Cut to flat size 6" x 16"
  Score, Collate, Stitch and Trim
  Finished Size:  6" x 8"

I will have someone come by and pick these up on Friday at 4:00pm as I am on way way to Phoenix right now. 

You can print on the Fuji or the Indigo. 

Please confirm receipt.


Thanks, 
Warren Hastings
Bison Graphics
972.467.8378


Thanks Warren!

I am getting this going.

Hi Brad,

Please send over a quote and turnaround timeline for what we call our Lookbook - I have uploaded the files to the Voom site (this will not the final, will have fully approved version to you by EOD tomorrow), for which which we would be looking at getting:
- Style: A center-stapled magazine style format with the same kind of semi-gloss thin pages they have; Aiming for very cost-effective as a lot of these get trashed during transport by sales reps or tossed by clients after a couple months.
- Pages: 16 total (first page in file functions as our ‘front cover’, with the last as our ‘back cover'
- Quantity: 1500
- Size: 8.5” x 11’

I’ve also included a video of our current print version to help clarify our vision as well.

============================

Hi Alex,


Please find you estimate for the Lookbook attached.  We would need 4-5 business days after proof approval to complete.


=============================

Hi Brad,

Fantastic! I just sent over the final file, looking forward to the proof!

=============================

Alex, 

In terms of order of pages would you like us to put them in alphabetic order?

If not please let me know what order you would like these in. 


==============================

Hi Brad,

File came over it somewhat of a "weird" size so prepress scaled it as close to 8.5" X 11" as we could and we ended up at 8.25" X 11"
